item.title: Meth surge hits Palm Beach County as cocaine prices push users to cheaper drugs
item.description: Federal agents in Palm Beach County seized about 54 kilos of methamphetamine in just two days, part of what they call an unprecedented surge tied to rising cocaine prices.

item.title: Port St. Lucie teen to serve as flag bearer at FIFA World Cup finals July 19
item.description: Enrique Rosario Liz, named Southeast Region Youth of the Year for Boys & Girls Clubs of America, was surprised Friday with a trip to the FIFA World Cup finals where he will serve as a Coca-Cola flag bearer.

item.title: Jupiter Inlet Lighthouse offers 165 years of history with panoramic views
item.description: Built in 1860, the Jupiter Inlet Lighthouse has guided ships along Florida's Atlantic coast for more than 165 years. The 105-step climb to the top rewards visitors with views of the Atlantic Ocean and the turquoise waters of the Jupiter Inlet.

item.title: Justin Bieber, Madonna to perform at World Cup final halftime show
item.description: Justin Bieber will join fellow headliners Madonna, Shakira and BTS in a star-studded World Cup halftime show outside New York on July 19.

item.title: Karolina Muchova defeats Coco Gauff at Wimbledon to reach final
item.description: Karolina Muchova ended Coco Gauff's run at Wimbledon with a 6-2, 1-6, 7-6 (10) victory Thursday in a drama-filled tiebreaker.

item.title: Port St. Lucie soccer stadium groundbreaking set for November as new renderings released
item.description: The 6,000-seat soccer stadium for Port St. Lucie SC will break ground in November at the Walton & One development on U.S. 1 and Walton Road, with new renderings released this week.
